top_signals.title: US Treasuries Yields Fall From 2002 High as Oil Prices Dip
top_signals.summary: US bond yields fell from their highest levels since 2002 as oil prices stabilized and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent insisted the government’s debt load can be tamed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: How quant funds beat the market by being 'early, contrarian and right'
top_signals.summary: Quantitative hedge funds have captured big trends in bonds and oil to outperform the stock market this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has ‘no legal entitlement’ to funds
top_signals.summary: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
